text:
maria.partnerships: FYI — HeliosAI dropped their onboarding bundle. Quick summary: weights under Apache-2.0 + separate "Non-Commercial Export Addendum" that (a) embargoes redistribution/downloads in EMEA for 90 days, (b) requires customer-managed KMS/HSM for any private deployments, and (c) asks for an origin chainproof. Can legal + security confirm if this blocks marketplace hosting or just downloadable assets? @sam.legal @kyle.security :eyes:

sam.legal: skimmed the doc — it's not pure Apache in practice because of the addendum. Clause 2.1 limits "commercial redistribution" for certain territories for 180 days (docs contradictory on 90 vs 180, need clarification). Important callouts: the addendum treats "hosting inference as a service" differently from "providing weights for download." We should push for explicit grant to host inference (marketplace SaaS) while honoring embargo on downloads.

kyle.security: KMS bits: they want keys held in customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and require HSM-backed EKM for any offline weight export. For hosted marketplace, they want us to sign an attestation that keys never leave our control — that is a non-starter. Practically: we can host in Dedicated/Private with CMK only; hosted API would need a contractual exception. Also ask Helios for specific rotation windows and audit log endpoints.

aj.cloud: Marketplace perspective — we can gate geography routing to exclude embargoed regions, and we can block the "download" SKU entirely until addendum lifts. That said, if hosting requires attestation we probably need a product-level exception or a partner-only Hosted SKU. Pricing consequences too.

dev.pm: Let's set a short clarifying call with Helios. Agenda: 1) Confirm embargo length (90 vs 180), 2) clarify hosting vs download rights, 3) exact KMS/HSM requirements and supported providers, 4) origin/provenance proof format they expect. I can propose tomorrow 11am PT.

sam.legal: +1 to call. Prep ask: ask them to provide the exact addendum text they'd want in our marketplace TOS (if they have it) and whether they'd accept a scoped grant: "Redwood may host inference in jurisdictions X but may not redistribute weights for Y days." Also request a sample attestation template for KMS.

kyle.security: Also request PoC logs/proof-of-origin format — a simple signed manifest with SHA256 checksums is fine, but need to confirm chain-of-custody for model training data (they may be unwilling). If they insist on HSM attestation for hosted service, we should flag as likely-blocker.

maria.partnerships: Cool. I'll send Helios a short note + calendar invite. Proposed message: "Thanks — can you confirm embargo length, whether hosted inference is allowed, and provide KMS attestation template & provenance manifest? We'll schedule a 30-min call to align." Will ping once calendar sent. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "HeliosAI onboarding sync" — tomorrow 11:00 AM PT — attendees: maria.partnerships, sam.legal, kyle.security, aj.cloud, dev.pm.

aj.cloud: I'll slot internal marketplace owners as observers. If Helios okays hosting-only model, we can fast-track a partner-hosted SKU.

maria.partnerships: Thanks everyone — plan: send clarifying questions now, hold the call, then decide hosting vs download path. I'll paste Helios reply in this thread when it arrives.
